description: Squat, bench press, deadlift and total percentiles for raw competition powerlifters, by sex, IPF weight class, age group and drug-tested status, from OpenPowerlifting’s public-domain meet results. Give a lift to place it among them. These describe competitive lifters, not the general gym population.

age.description: Optional: age in years, for the age group (14-18, 19-23, 24-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+). Omit for all ages.

bodyweight.description: Bodyweight in the chosen unit; it sets the IPF weight class.

lift.description: squat, bench, deadlift, or total (squat + bench + deadlift).

scope.description: all federations, or tested: drug-tested categories only.

sex.description: The sex category the lifter competes in.

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

weight.description: Optional: the lifter’s best for that lift, to place among the percentiles.

name: strength_standards
title: Strength standards
